user.title: TCL TV
user.description: The TV must be on and reachable on the LAN (UDP 6537 / TCP 6553).

error.cannot_connect: No TCL+ / T-Cast remote service answered at this address. Is the TV on?

init.title: TCL TV options
init.description:
IR power-on: {power_on}
Input sources: {source_count}. Select an item and press Save to configure it, or press Save with nothing selected to write the current settings.

data_description.next: Select IR power-on or Input sources, then Save to open it. Leave empty and press Save to write settings.

power_on.title: IR power-on remote
power_on.description: Pick an infrared remote (Broadlink, Harmony Hub, or Xiaomi Home). Leave empty to keep using Wake-on-LAN.

data_description.power_on_remote: A Home Assistant remote entity that has learned IR codes.
data_description.go_back: Turn this on, then press the button to go back without saving this page.

ir_details.title: Power-on IR command
ir_details.description: Choose the learned device and command for {remote_entity} (codes file: {codes_file}).

data_description.power_on_device: Device name from the remote's learned codes. Required for Harmony Hub and Xiaomi Home.
data_description.power_on_command: Command name from that device (for example Power or power_on).
data_description.go_back: Turn this on, then press the button to go back without saving this page.

sources.title: Input sources
sources.description:
Named HDMI/AV inputs with a press sequence (this TV's keys and/or button entities, for example Source → Right → OK). Hidden sources stay in this list but not on the media player. Current: {source_names}
Select an action and press Save, or press Save with nothing selected to write all sources. Choose Back, then Save, to return.

data_description.next: Add, edit, delete, reorder, or go back. Leave empty to save.

source_add.title: Add input source
source_add.description: Name the input first. Next you choose this TV's keys or button entities, then how many times to press each one.

data_description.name: Shown on media_player.select_source (for example HDMI 1).
data_description.hidden: Keep the source configured but omit it from the TV source list.
data_description.interval: Seconds to wait after each press except the last.
data_description.go_back: Turn this on, then press the button to go back without saving this page.
Turn this on, then press the button to go back without saving this page.

data_description.name: Shown on media_player.select_source (for example HDMI 1).
data_description.hidden: Keep the source configured but omit it from the TV source list.
data_description.interval: Seconds to wait after each press except the last.
data_description.edit_sequence: Turn on to pick TV keys or button entities again and set how many times each is pressed.
data_description.go_back: Turn this on, then press the button to go back without saving this page.

source_seq_kind.title: Press sequence type
source_seq_kind.description:
Current sequence: {sequence}
Choose this TV's keys or Home Assistant button entities. You can add the other kind afterwards.

data_description.next: This TV's keys or button entities.
data_description.go_back: Turn this on, then press the button to go back without saving this page.

source_seq_pick.title: Choose presses
source_seq_pick.description:
Using {kind}. Current sequence: {sequence}
Pick items in the order they should be sent. Next you will set how many times each one is pressed.

data_description.actions: Drag to reorder. Each item is listed once; repeats are set on the next screen.
data_description.go_back: Turn this on, then press the button to go back without saving this page.

data_description.add_more: Turn on to append more TV keys or button entities after these.
data_description.go_back: Turn this on, then press the button to go back without saving this page.

source_delete.title: Delete input source
source_delete.description: Remove a source from the list. This cannot be undone after Save.

data_description.go_back: Turn this on, then press the button to go back without saving this page.

source_reorder.title: Reorder input sources
source_reorder.description: All input sources are listed. Drag to change the order shown on the media player. Keep every source in the list.

data_description.go_back: Turn this on, then press the button to go back without saving this page.

error.buttons_required: Select at least one TV key or button entity.
error.pick_required: Select at least one item of this type.
error.unknown_action: That press sequence has an unknown key or button.
error.command_required: Select or enter the IR command name.
error.device_required: This remote requires a device name.
error.name_in_use: That source name is already used.
error.unknown_source: That source is not in the list.
